recording_session_description: Project-owner-attested single continuous recording session; platform asset ID is not asserted to be a device-native session identifier.
selection_basis: Selected as a complete continuous video before inspecting held-out references, target-event statistics, candidate-event mappings, or B0/A1-A4 method results.
independence_basis: The project owner declares a distinct recording session with no shared parent video, recording session, or known content derivation path with long_video_dataset3, existing design videos, or the other replication video.

source_attestation.verification_scope: Owner-declared provenance; not independently verified from the Bilibili webpage.
source_attestation.notes: Automated Bilibili retrieval returned HTTP 412. Eligibility relies on this explicit project-owner provenance declaration and the frozen local video hash, not on platform provenance metadata.

source_verification.verification_method: PROJECT_OWNER_ATTESTATION bound to local SHA-256; URL/asset ID retained for source traceability.
source_verification.verification_notes: Third-party source verification is not established and is not required under the provenance-only eligibility amendment when the owner attestation and hash binding validate.
